title: How creeds take shape
summary: Creeds as an emerging hunter society.

claims.text: Hunters only sharpen their approach once wholly devoted to the hunt; then creeds begin to work as social groups, with Avenger knowing Avenger and Innocent knowing Innocent by shared aims.
That may take months or years, slowed by the many edges hunters of every outlook seem to share.
Some hope recognised creeds will give the hunt its momentum; others fear the divisions will sink it in infighting and politics.

title: Avenger slang
summary: Words spreading on the Avengers' firelight email list.

claims.text: Avengers on the firelight list call a ghoul a bruise, from the bluish pallor second sight can show, a vampire a fang, a shapechanger a flicker or lobo, and a witch a merlin.
Rot means the undead in general, a stub is a shambler and a wisp a ghost; drones are people blind to monsters, and the wake-up is becoming imbued.
Hunter types get names too: a bullseye snipes, a demo likes explosives, a pyro favours fire and a shitkicker fights hand to hand; a Jones leads a personality cult whose members are echoes.
